sentences.text: Meine Eltern mögen meinen Freund nicht.
sentences.en: My parents don't like my boyfriend.

sentences.text: Was mögen Sie lieber, Tee oder Kaffee?
sentences.en: Which do you prefer, tea or coffee?

sentences.text: Viele Leute mögen das Wetter in London nicht.
sentences.en: Lots of people don't like the weather in London.

sentences.text: Sie mögen recht haben, aber ich glaube das nicht.
sentences.en: You may be right, but I don't believe it.
sentences.review: Epistemic 'mögen' (= may) is formal or literary and quite different from 'like', yet this first and only example has no grammar note; consider adding a short note saying it is a formal concession ('Sie mögen recht haben, aber…') and that everyday speech would use 'Sie haben vielleicht recht'.
